speaker: voicedata-candidate-b
prosody_source: Voice B training-set mean of foundation-normalized prosody features

serving.selection_score: speaker_similarity - 1.0 * cer, optionally minus 0.05 * F0-envelope penalty

notes: crossflow-candidate-consistency-v1 fine-tunes the CFG checkpoint with Voice B replayed at roughly forty percent of training duration, sharpening the conditional distribution around the Candidate voice; the persona-flip rate falls at the source rather than only through selection. The envelope-gated selection additionally scores each take's measured log-F0 statistics against real Voice B recordings, trading a little verifier similarity for pitch-envelope fidelity that the saturated verifier cannot see; choose between the plain and gated packages by native listening. Reference-infilling experiments (crossflow-infill-foundation-v1/v2) were abandoned: they reached the highest verifier similarity but never achieved intelligible alignment for concatenated reference-plus-target text within the available fine-tuning budget; their checkpoints and the context-conditioning code path (inert by default, fully tested) are retained.
